title: First Steps Helper: Maximum of Two Values
description: Booklet Section 10.1 helper selecting the maximum of two adjustable values A and B.

walkthrough.title: Generate A and B
walkthrough.text: P1 and P2 are each mapped through a 2*k-1 helper to create adjustable source stubs A and B.

walkthrough.title: Test A-B
walkthrough.text: INV3 forms -B. CMP1 receives A and -B, so its sign test is A-B.

walkthrough.title: Route the greater value
walkthrough.text: The comparator positive branch is A and the non-positive branch is B, so OUT Y shows max(A,B).
